Percentile value of measured test samples for which download and upload speed is ≥ offered typical download and upload speed in tariff offerings (i) The download speed is defined as the data transmission rate that is achieved for downloading a test file from a test server to a test device. (ii) The service providers have been mandated to disclose the typical download and upload speeds offered to the subscribers in respective service area.
